Artist: BÈFÈ THE MAD

Hack The System

Hack The System is a performance that captures a transformation unfolding on stage. At NFC Lisbon 2025, in the midst of the audience, something took shape almost like a ritual. A body, a mind, an identity broke apart and reshaped itself.

This piece tells the story of a figure who rejects the definitions imposed by the system, abandons centralized structures, and carves out their own path. It is not rebellion for the sake of rebellion, but a search for freedom. Not an escape but a conscious disconnection.

The music was woven with the same emotions. Every rhythm, every silence, every sound was placed like a fragment. The transformation happened not only in the body but within the sound itself.
